proof_scope: retained guidance contract for Chatterbox emotional rendering, memory grounding, spaced ellipsis pauses, render_chunks silence, and analyzer evaluation

claims.proves: the skill document preserves the Chatterbox render-quality contract and exposes concrete JSON examples for agents
claims.does_not_prove: live Chatterbox synthesis quality, human preference, or waveform measurements; those belong to analyze-chatterbox-emotions and Chatterbox retained evals

cases.name: missing-required-contract-fails-adversarially
command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/best-practices-chatterbox && python3 - <<'PY'
from scripts import check_contract
result=check_contract.evaluate('name: best-practices-chatterbox\n')
assert result['pass'] is False
assert 'memory_route' in result['missing']
assert 'pause_after_ms' in result['missing']
print('PASS_ADVERSARIAL_CONTRACT_MISSING_REQUIRED_TEXT')
PY

cases.name: text-ssml-pause-and-sweep-tools
command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/best-practices-chatterbox && ./run.sh plan-silence --text 'I need a second. [pause:1.2s] [sniff] [sniff] ... give me a second.' --tone grief_safe > /tmp/best-practices-chatterbox-render-plan.json && ./run.sh sweep-plan --text 'I cannot believe you pulled this off! ... [gasp] That was incredible.' > /tmp/best-practices-chatterbox-sweep-plan.json && ./run.sh ssml --text '<speak>Wait <break time="800ms"/><express-as type="gasp">look out</express-as></speak>' > /tmp/best-practices-chatterbox-ssml.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
plan=json.loads(Path('/tmp/best-practices-chatterbox-render-plan.json').read_text())
sweep=json.loads(Path('/tmp/best-practices-chatterbox-sweep-plan.json').read_text())
ssml=json.loads(Path('/tmp/best-practices-chatterbox-ssml.json').read_text())
assert plan['render_chunks'][0]['pause_after_ms'] == 1200
assert '[pause:' not in plan['answer_text']
assert sweep['run_count'] == 16
assert '[pause:800ms]' in ssml['text']
assert '... [gasp]' in ssml['text']
print('PASS_CHATTERBOX_CONTRACT_TOOLS')
PY
